title: Invest.Rio firma parceria para levar dez startups cariocas ao Web Summit Lisboa (Correio da Manha, 25 October 2026)
what_it_says: Correio da Manha reports the Invest.Rio and Gol partnership for the Missao Web Summit Lisboa 2026 and dates the event 8 to 12 November, where Web Summit and the other two sources say 9 to 12.
